item.title: Carney suspends Canada's fuel tax in first act after securing a majority government
item.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has suspended the fuel tax in response to the Iran war

item.title: US forces to join combat drills in Philippines to show commitment to Asia while fighting Iran
item.summary: Officials say more than 17,000 American and Philippine military personnel will participate in one of their largest annual combat exercises in the country that underscore the United States’ continuing security commitment to Asia

item.title: Sudan enters a fourth year of war as officials lament an 'abandoned crisis'
item.summary: Sudan is entering a fourth year of war marked by famine and massacres in what the United Nations calls an “abandoned crisis.”

item.title: Xi and Sánchez say China and Spain should help safeguard multilateralism
item.summary: The leaders of China and Spain on Tuesday have pledged to strengthen their relations and work to safeguard multilateralism at a time when the world is being impacted by various conflicts, including the recent war in Iran

item.title: Afghan migrants in Poland fear forced deportations as asylum applications remain suspended
item.summary: Afghan migrants in Poland face forced deportations and fear for their lives at the hands of the Taliban-run government back home

item.title: Mediators move closer to extending US-Iran ceasefire, officials tell AP
item.summary: Mediators are moving closer to extending the ceasefire between the United States and Iran and restarting negotiations to salvage the fragile truce before it expires next week

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy pursues more arms deals with allies to help check Russia's invasion
item.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine’s top priority is securing help to buy and build more air defense systems

item.title: Afghanistan's capital is in the grip of a water crisis
item.summary: Nestled in a high-altitude valley in Afghanistan's Hindu Kush mountain range, Kabul is rapidly running out of water

item.title: Heavy rains in northwestern Haiti kill 12 people and damage hundreds of homes
item.summary: Authorities say heavy rains in northwestern Haiti killed at least 12 people, flooded farmland and damaged hundreds of homes

item.title: Bahamas police release Michigan man questioned after his wife disappeared from the couple’s boat
item.summary: Police in the Bahamas have released a Michigan man who said his wife disappeared after falling overboard from a small boat in waters off the island nation
